internal_split.rule: within-source SHA-256 rank, first floor(60%) QUALITY_FIT, rest OPERATING_CAL

methods.dda_global: official DDA probability + OPERATING_CAL REAL-10% threshold
methods.fusion_global: frozen E44 fusion probability + OPERATING_CAL REAL-10% threshold
methods.fusion_quality_gaussian: QuAD-inspired class-conditional Gaussian of frozen-fusion logit given three standardized quality proxies; ridge=1.0; OPERATING_CAL REAL-10% threshold

selection.fallback: if none eligible, choose same ordering but mark calibration failure
selection.global: eligible DDA/fusion ordered by worst-generator recall, AI recall, AUC, then DDA simplicity
selection.quality_replacement: eligible quality method must be non-inferior to best global in REAL FP, AI recall, worst-generator recall and AUC, and improve at least one recall/AUC metric by >=0.01

selective_policy: AI cut is binary cut; choose CAL-only REAL cut maximizing automatic coverage with covered accuracy >=0.95 and uncertainty <=0.20; otherwise REAL cut equals AI cut
